pieces.Text: A dashing thief's panache is fueled by bold acts of thievery. Whenever a dashing thief uses the steal combat maneuver to steal an object worth at least

gp from an opponent, she regains 1 panache point. She cannot regain panache in this way from a given opponent more than once per day. This ability alters panache and replaces the swashbuckler's ability to regain panache from a killing blow.
